groups.saying_opens: ليست نفس مخلوقة إلا الله خالقها

notes: Two sayings, each with its own isnad (rule 4a): the first is the answer on «العزل», the second «ليست نفس مخلوقة»; each group carries its saying label.
«هو ابن عقبة» is a gloss, left out; «أبا سعيد» in the second saying is written as the text has it and is not merged with «أبي سعيد الخدري».
